We need Chris Rabb in Congress. I’m proud to endorse him! Let’s Organize.


Chris Rabb (@chrisrabb)

Big News: @MaxwellFrostfl endorsed our campaign!

As the only Gen Z member of Congress, Maxwell Frost is inspiring young people to fight for:

✅Livable Wage For All
✅Medicare For All
✅Housing For All

Philly can be a city affordable for all of us. That's what I'm fighting for.





— https://nitter.net/chrisrabb/status/2050967627569230093#m
